entities.name: Ruhan
entities.description: A legendary blind horned giant warrior of the Fomori from the plane of Ir, who wields a great mace and answers only to his whim.

entities.name: Fomori
entities.description: Race of giants whose swordmasters trained Ruhan.

events.summary: Born blind, Ruhan chooses a life of war and is trained by the swordmasters of the Fomori.
events.quote: Born blind, the horned giant Ruhan chose a life of war.
